w.tut.1.text: Blue Tiger Wallet keeps your digital ID and university degree on your phone. You decide what to share, and with whom.
w.tut.1.title: Your credentials, in your pocket
w.tut.2.text: Hold your passport or ID card in front of the camera. It is captured automatically once the lines at the bottom are readable. Or upload a photo or PDF.
w.tut.2.title: Scan your document
w.tut.3.text: Place your passport against the back of the phone and keep still. Reading the chip gives the highest level of assurance.
w.tut.3.title: Or read the chip (NFC)
w.tut.4.text: Blink, then turn your head to both sides and look straight ahead. We compare your face with the document portrait.
w.tut.4.title: Prove it is you
w.tut.5.text: Issuers show a QR code and sometimes a PIN. Scan it, enter the PIN and your credential is added. You can also type your details on the issuer’s website.
w.tut.5.title: Scan a QR code and enter the PIN
w.tut.6.text: Online: scan a website’s QR code or tap its link. In person: show your QR code to a verifier’s phone. Both work without typing anything.
w.tut.6.title: Share online or in person
w.tut.7.text: Before anything is shared you see exactly what is requested and approve it with your fingerprint or PIN. Share only what is needed.
w.tut.7.title: You stay in control
